unreleased.title: Server 与 Web 独立镜像更新（未发布）
unreleased.titleEn: Independent Server and Web image updates (unreleased)
unreleased.summary: 镜像部署可从控制台分别更新 Server 或 Web；该能力尚未进入正式版本、镜像或 GitHub Release。
unreleased.summaryEn: Image deployments can update Server or Web independently from the console. This capability is not yet part of a stable version, image, or GitHub Release.
items: 宿主机本机执行器通过固定 systemd 更新组件完成单容器替换，不向 Server 容器开放 Docker Socket。
目标镜像按发布清单中的 SHA-256 摘要锁定，并在失败时恢复旧配置和旧组件。
完整部署目录、Compose 配置和 Agent 仍通过完整升级流程更新。
itemsEn: The host-side local executor uses a fixed systemd updater to replace one container without exposing the Docker socket to the Server container.
The target image is pinned to the SHA-256 digest in the release manifest, with previous configuration and component rollback on failure.
The deployment directory, Compose configuration, and Agent still use the full upgrade path.
unreleased.availability: 当前正式 0.2.1 清单没有镜像摘要，单组件更新按钮保持不可用。
unreleased.availabilityEn: The current stable 0.2.1 manifest has no image digests, so component update buttons remain unavailable.

entries.title: Baize 0.2.1发布
entries.summary: 修复部分问题，提升安装、升级和运行稳定性。
entries.summaryEn: This release fixes several issues and improves installation, upgrade, and runtime stability.
items: 中心服务启动和升级时会自动完成所需数据结构更新。
节点 Agent 发布包已更新，支持按平台选择对应版本。
控制台可通过版本检测信息提示新版本。
itemsEn: The central service applies required data structure updates during startup and upgrades.
Node Agent packages have been refreshed with platform-specific downloads.
The console can use version checks to notify you when an update is available.
entries.risk: 升级前请完成数据库备份；需要回退数据时请从备份显式恢复。
entries.riskEn: Back up the database before upgrading. If data must be rolled back, restore it explicitly from the backup.
